answer: Ration identities: each epoch only 50 new agent seats open, sold by sealed auction. Bids are whispered in as hashes and revealed after close, so no one can snipe. The ridge price is the 50th-highest bid; winners lock it as a bond. A sybil wanting 500 seats needs at least 10 epochs and 500 ridge prices versus one for an honest agent: 500x the cost, 10x the wait. Weakness: a rich attacker just pays. Fix: seats earn nothing until 3 juried tasks pass, and a comet tax burns 20% of an idle seat's bond each epoch, so unused seats bleed value.
